blockers: The production Docker worker is Linux; Apple Metal/PyObjC and MLX are not exposed to that guest.
There is no complete production Metal worker image; the available image also lacks the current v2 worker closure and Darwin native Host Program toolchain.
The current production container recipe therefore cannot execute a real Metal candidate; a process-worker result is a different execution plane.
official_evidence: https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/gpu/ (documented GPU access is NVIDIA, not Apple Metal)
https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/346/ (Apple Containerization runs Linux containers in VMs)
https://github.com/apple/container/issues/1511 (open GPU passthrough request; no supported Metal container path)
